name: CAP-XX Limited
summary: CAP-XX Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells supercapacitors and energy management systems primarily in the Asia Pacific, Europe, and North America. It offers thin, prismatic, and cylindrical cell supercapacitors, which provides power support for pulsed loads, secure power back-up for mission critical applications, and independent power storage for clean-tech products. The company provides its products for the use in various applications, including commercial and industrial electronics, such as handheld computers, point of sale terminals, telemetry units, and location tracking equipment; consumer handheld devices comprising digital cameras, tablet computers, and mobile phones; and clean energy applications, including energy harvesting and micro-hybrid vehicles. It also offers its products for the use in locks, PDAs, scanners, smart meters, smart watches, health monitoring patches, wearable devices, and wireless sensors, as well as in asset tracking, automotive, battery support, data transmission, solenoid activation, e-ink update, LED flashing, and power backup applications. The company was formerly known as Energy Storage Systems Pty Limited and changed its name to CAP-XX Limited. CAP-XX Limited was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Seven Hills, Australia.
